news.title: A Nasdaq-listed company may sell $450 million bitcoin, citing Binance hack and quantum fears
news.summary: Next Technology Holding cited exchange security and quantum computing risks in authorizing sales or loans against its 5,833 BTC. It says none of the coins are held at Binance.

news.title: 18 years in, what has Bitcoin truly done?
news.summary: The Bitcoin white paper achieved a lot of what Satoshi Nakamoto set out to accomplish, but the cultural impact it had may outweigh Bitcoin itself, writes CoinDesk's Nikhilesh De.

news.title: As big bitcoin miners chase AI profits, individuals get another shot at the rewards
news.summary: Several companies offer access to bitcoin mining without the hassle of running equipment, but high costs and the 2028 reward halving make profits uncertain.

news.title: Institutions embrace crypto staking despite shrinking yields
news.summary: Easier access and growing familiarity are encouraging investors to stake their tokens, while falling rewards and withdrawal delays test the economics.

news.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach
news.summary: Binance is absorbing all losses through corporate funds, futures reserves, and SAFU, keeping user balances intact.

news.title: Traders are already placing leveraged bets on Anthropic’s IPO using crypto contracts
news.summary: Trade.xyz’s new ANT contract fell about 20% in its first hour on Hyperliquid. There are no shares behind it, and U.S. traders are locked out.

news.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem
news.summary: Two strangers befriended Magnus Ahmad outside a London bar. Hours later, thieves had emptied his crypto wallets, accessed his bank accounts and disabled his laptop.

news.title: Bitcoin's white paper turns 18, and small businesses are still paying for the bailouts it answered

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
